title: Homework after Lesson 2
note: Do everything on the site, not in your notebook — then I can see your answers and help with the mistakes.

items.text: Exercise 13: write 60–80 words about someone you know — on the lesson page.

Finish Exercises 11 and 12 on the lesson page if you did not do them in class.
Lesson 1: open it and check Exercises 13, 14 and 15. If they are empty, do them on the page.

title: Homework after Lesson 1
note: Do a little every day instead of everything on the last evening. The grammar quizzes take 5 minutes each.

items.text: Exercise 15: write 50–70 words about your typical weekday.
Learn the 20 words from Lesson 1 — use the flashcards in the Vocabulary section.
Grammar section: take the quizzes on to be, Present Simple and he / she / it spelling.
Finish Exercises 13 and 14 on the lesson page if you did not do them in class.
Optional: open zno.osvita.ua (Links section) and just look at one NMT English test. Do not try to do it yet.
